voice-branch-jargon.notes: Branch/audit working labels leaking into published prose (the .md body). workplan / phase / tranche item label — 'workplan'; e.g. "...bolic-in-$q$ throughout](https://github.com/litlfred/qou/blob/main/docs/audits/-math-framework-workplan.md#p25)). - $\mathfrak{E}_0$ has two framework-derived forms and one CODATA cross-check, all...". audit / coordination doc path — 'docs/audits/'; e.g. "...final reporting step ([symbolic-in-$q$ throughout](https://github.com/litlfred/qou/blob/main/docs/audits/-math-framework-workplan.md#p25)). - $\mathfrak{E}_0$ has two framework-derived forms and one C...". What these actually are: P#.#, 'Phase N', 'Track N', 'step-9b' and the '13-driver menu' are workplan item ids; audit and coordination docs are internal working records.
